items.title: Our position on open-weights models

items.summary_zh: 一篇关于开放权重模型立场的声明文章，阐述了作者所在组织对开源AI模型的态度。文章认为开放权重模型能促进技术透明和社区创新，但也指出需要警惕恶意使用风险。这是一篇平衡了开放精神与安全责任的讨论，适合关注AI政策与治理的读者。
items.summary_en: This is a position statement on open-weights models, outlining the author's organization's stance on open-source AI models. The article argues that open-weights models can foster technical transparency and community innovation, but also warns of the risks of malicious use. This balanced discussion on openness versus safety is relevant for readers interested in AI policy and governance.

items.title: 7.1 Earthquake in Japan
items.author: krembo
items.summary_zh: 日本发生7.1级地震，震感强烈，但未引发严重海啸。这次事件再次凸显了地震预警系统的重要性，以及日本在防灾科技方面的领先地位。对于科技行业而言，这也是检验各种通信和监测设备实际性能的契机。
items.summary_en: A 7.1 magnitude earthquake shook Japan with strong tremors, but did not trigger a major tsunami. The event once again underscores the importance of earthquake early warning systems and Japan's leadership in disaster prevention technology. For the tech industry, it also serves as a real-world test of various communication and monitoring devices.

items.title: Stop Killing the Internet: No Digital ID and No Age Verification
items.author: doener
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章强烈反对在互联网上强制推行数字身份认证和年龄验证制度，认为这些措施会扼杀网络自由、侵犯隐私并制造新的控制壁垒。作者主张保持匿名和开放的原则，指出真正的问题在于监管过度而非缺乏验证。这篇文章引发了关于安全与自由平衡的激烈讨论，尤其适合关心数字权利的普通网民阅读。
items.summary_en: This piece argues against mandatory digital IDs and age verification on the internet, claiming such measures kill the open nature of the web, invade privacy, and create new forms of control. The author advocates for maintaining anonymity and freedom, suggesting that the real danger lies in overregulation rather than a lack of verification. It's a thought-provoking read for anyone concerned about digital rights and the future of online expression.

items.title: KOReader
items.author: Cider9986
items.summary_zh: 这款开源引擎能让任何搭载 M 系列芯片的 Mac 仅用 2GB 内存就跑动 Gemma 4 26B 大语言模型。通过极致的量化与内存优化技术，它打破了本地运行大型 AI 模型的高硬件门槛，让普通 Mac 用户也能尝试前沿研究。对于 AI 爱好者、学生和预算有限的开发者来说，这是一个令人兴奋的突破，意味着更低的实验成本和更便捷的本地推理体验。
items.summary_en: This open-source engine makes it possible to run the large language model Gemma 4 26B on any M-series Mac with just 2GB of RAM. Through aggressive quantization and memory optimization, it lowers the hardware barrier for running cutting-edge AI locally. This is a game-changer for AI enthusiasts, students, and developers with limited resources, enabling them to experiment and develop applications without expensive cloud GPUs or high-end workstations.

items.title: New HIV vaccine shows unprecedented success in preclinical study
items.author: codebyaditya
items.summary_zh: 一种新型HIV疫苗在临床前研究中取得了前所未有的成功，引发了医学界的极大关注。该疫苗通过创新的免疫机制设计，展示了显著的抗病毒效果，为最终战胜艾滋病带来了新的希望。目前研究团队正积极推进下一阶段的临床试验。
items.summary_en: A new HIV vaccine has achieved unprecedented success in preclinical studies, sparking significant excitement in the medical community. Through an innovative immune mechanism design, the vaccine demonstrates remarkable antiviral efficacy, offering renewed hope for ultimately conquering AIDS. The research team is now actively advancing toward the next phase of clinical trials.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source engine running Gemma 4 26B in 2 GB RAM on any M-series Mac
items.author: gitpusher42
items.summary_zh: 一个开源项目实现了在2GB内存的M系列Mac上本地运行Gemma 4 26B模型。通过先进的量化技术和内存优化算法，这个引擎大幅降低了运行大语言模型的硬件门槛。普通Mac用户无需昂贵的工作站或云端服务，就能在本地运行强大的AI模型，既保护了数据隐私，又降低了使用成本。对开源AI社区的普及和民主化具有重要意义。
items.summary_en: A new open-source engine enables running Google's Gemma 4 26B model in just 2GB of RAM on any M-series Mac. This is a significant breakthrough for on-device AI, achieved through advanced quantization and aggressive memory optimization techniques. Previously, running a model of this size required substantial memory or cloud computing resources. Now, everyday Mac users can execute powerful language models locally without expensive hardware or cloud subscriptions, while keeping their data private. This project exemplifies the ongoing democratization of AI — lowering the barrier to entry for developers, researchers, and hobbyists who want to experiment with state-of-the-art models on consumer hardware.

items.title: Substack writers, you need a website
items.author: speckx
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章提醒Substack作者，不要完全依赖平台，应该建立自己的独立网站来掌控内容和读者关系。虽然Substack方便快捷，但一旦平台政策变动或者账号出现问题，你的读者和数据都可能受到影响。通过自己的网站，你可以拥有更自由的变现方式、更直接的互动渠道，还能避免算法流量的不确定性。对于认真写内容、想长期经营的创作者来说，这不仅是备份，更是品牌护城河。
items.summary_en: This article argues that Substack writers should invest in their own independent websites rather than relying solely on the platform. While Substack offers convenience, it also comes with risks like policy changes, algorithmic unpredictability, and potential account issues that could leave you disconnected from your audience. By owning a website, you gain full control over your content, monetization, and reader relationships. It acts as a brand fortress, ensuring your work isn't held hostage by a single platform. Serious creators looking for long-term stability and deeper audience engagement will find this advice essential.

items.title: Codex Security
items.author: bakigul
items.summary_zh: Codex Security是一款面向开发团队的安全分析工具，专注于在代码层面发现漏洞并提供自动修复建议。它深度集成到开发流程中，能在代码提交前就预警安全问题，减少事后补漏洞的麻烦。对于追求DevSecOps的团队来说，这款工具可以帮助他们把安全左移，在不牺牲速度的前提下提升代码质量。它的独特之处在于结合了静态分析与上下文理解，从而减少误报，让开发者更愿意使用。
items.summary_en: Codex Security is a developer‑friendly security analysis tool that catches vulnerabilities in code before they reach production. It integrates directly into the CI/CD pipeline, offering automated remediation suggestions rather than just raw warnings. By combining static analysis with contextual understanding, it significantly reduces false positives—a major pain point for busy developers. Teams aiming for a smooth DevSecOps workflow will appreciate how it shifts security left without slowing down delivery. The tool is designed to be unobtrusive, helping developers write safer code while staying productive.

items.title: Superlogical
items.author: yan
items.summary_zh: Superlogical是一个通过自然语言描述来自动化逻辑推理和流程编排的工具。用户只需用简单的语言说明需求，它就能自动生成可执行的逻辑规则，适合处理复杂的决策树或业务规则。对于那些需要快速验证算法正确性，或者要在系统中嵌入逻辑推理能力的人来说，Superlogical降低了门槛。它像是一个懂你意图的逻辑引擎，把繁琐的规则编写变成对话式的体验。
items.summary_en: Superlogical is a tool that turns natural language descriptions into executable logic rules and workflows. Instead of manually coding complex decision trees or business rules, you simply describe what you want, and it handles the translation. This makes it a game‑changer for developers and analysts who need to quickly prototype or embed reasoning capabilities into their systems. It lowers the barrier for automating logic, transforming a traditionally tedious task into a conversational interaction. Think of it as a logic engine that understands your intent and builds the rules for you.

items.title: Kimi K3 Architecture Overview and Notes
items.author: ModelForge
items.summary_zh: Kimi K3架构是一套针对高性能计算场景设计的芯片方案，其核心特点是异构计算单元的高效协作与极致能效比。文章详细梳理了K3的内存层次、互联拓扑以及编译栈设计，展示了如何在有限功耗下榨取更多算力。对于从事芯片设计、系统架构或底层性能优化的工程师来说，这份笔记提供了宝贵的设计思路和实战经验，尤其是它在AI推理与科学计算场景下的表现值得关注。
items.summary_en: This post provides a deep dive into the Kimi K3 architecture, a chip design tailored for high‑performance computing with a focus on heterogeneous compute units and energy efficiency. The author breaks down its memory hierarchy, interconnect topology, and compiler stack, showing how the architecture extracts maximum performance within tight power budgets. Engineers working on chip design, system architecture, or low‑level optimization will find practical insights here. The K3's approach to balancing AI inference and scientific computing workloads makes it a particularly interesting reference for modern accelerator design.

If you're building AI-powered coding tools or want to inject disciplined structure into your development workflow, this project offers a fresh, actionable approach.

By exposing the hidden instructions that shape how these models behave, it offers rare insight into prompt engineering, safety guardrails, and role-setting techniques. AI researchers and developers can learn how top models are orchestrated, but the leak also raises important questions about access control and intellectual property in the generative AI race.

items.summary_en: Prelint is a linter purpose‑built for AI‑generated code, tackling the growing problem of product drift—where code compiles and runs but subtly strays from business requirements. It uses custom rules and semantic analysis to catch these mismatches before they hit production. For teams relying on AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot or OpenAI Codex, Prelint acts as a quality gate, ensuring the output aligns with actual product intent. Developers who want to accelerate with AI without sacrificing accuracy will find it an indispensable safety net. It bridges the gap between fast code generation and reliable software delivery.

For beginners, this eliminates the need for expensive in-person lessons, giving them a personal coach available around the clock. Advanced players can use it to refine subtle imperfections and improve expressiveness. By combining artificial intelligence with music education, SoundGate solves the core problem of self-learning—the lack of immediate feedback—making practice sessions both effective and engaging.

By removing the friction around getting paid, Denovo lets builders focus on what they care about: making a product people love. This is a legitimate bridge between rapid AI-assisted creation and sustainable commercial success.

items.description: Give Claude Code missions to spawn a team of agents
items.summary_zh: /mission 为 Claude Code 增加了一条斜杠命令，允许用户定义一项“使命”并自动派生出多个子代理并行处理代码任务。它适用于大型代码库的重构、跨文件修改和多模块测试，让 Claude Code 从单线程问答变成可编排的多代理协作。
items.summary_en: /mission is a slash command for Claude Code that lets you set a mission and automatically spawn a team of sub-agents to work in parallel. It's designed for large-scale refactoring, cross-file edits, or multi-module testing, scaling Claude Code from one-off chatbot responses to coordinated agent workflows.

items.title: ClinicFrame
items.description: Like Granola, but for healthcare. Fully HIPAA-compliant.

items.title: Prefactor
items.description: Evaluate your AI Agents in real-time
items.summary_zh: Prefactor 是一款实时评估AI代理性能的工具，它让开发者可以持续监控智能体的行为，及时发现异常并优化部署。对于正在构建生产级AI系统的团队来说，它解决了“黑箱”问题，确保代理在真实环境中稳定可靠地运行。无论是聊天机器人还是自动化流程，Prefactor 都能提供关键的洞察。
items.summary_en: Prefactor is a tool that evaluates AI agents in real time, allowing developers to continuously monitor agent behavior, catch anomalies early, and optimize deployments. For teams building production-grade AI systems, it solves the black-box problem, ensuring agents run stably and reliably in real-world environments. Whether for chatbots or automated workflows, Prefactor provides critical insights.

items.title: Cekura
items.description: The self-improvement loop for voice agents
items.summary_zh: Cekura 是一款专为语音代理设计的自我改进循环工具，它通过自动记录和分析语音交互中的错误与成功案例，帮助开发者持续优化语音助手的表现。这个工具的核心价值在于让语音代理能够像人类一样从每次对话中学习，从而提升准确率和用户体验。对于那些正在构建客服、智能家居或车载语音系统的团队来说，Cekura 可以大幅减少手动调试和标注的时间，让迭代变得更加高效。
items.summary_en: Cekura is a self-improvement loop designed specifically for voice agents, automatically logging and analyzing every interaction to identify errors and successes. By enabling voice assistants to learn from each conversation, it helps developers continuously refine performance without manual intervention. This tool is particularly valuable for teams building customer service bots, smart home assistants, or in-car voice systems, as it significantly reduces debugging and annotation time, making iterative improvements faster and more data-driven.

items.title: Lottie Creator 2.0
items.description: After Effects for the web, built on Lottie
items.summary_zh: Lottie Creator 2.0 是一款基于 Lottie 的网页版动画制作工具，被誉为“网页上的 After Effects”。它让设计师无需安装专业软件，直接在浏览器中创建和编辑矢量动画，并导出轻量级的 Lottie 文件。这对前端工程师和 UI 设计师来说是个福音，因为动画文件更小、性能更好，而且可以无缝嵌入到网站和移动应用中。新版本还增加了更丰富的编辑功能和性能优化，进一步降低了高质量动画的制作门槛。
items.summary_en: Lottie Creator 2.0 is a web-based animation tool built on the Lottie framework, often described as After Effects for the browser. It allows designers to create and edit vector animations directly in their browser without installing heavy desktop software, and export lightweight Lottie files. This is a game-changer for front-end developers and UI designers because the resulting animations are small, performant, and seamlessly integrate into websites and mobile apps. The 2.0 version introduces richer editing capabilities and performance improvements, further lowering the barrier to producing high-quality animations.

items.title: Leaping AI
items.description: AI agents that call and text in multi-day campaigns

items.title: Hardbook
items.description: The freelancer booking link that signs the contract for you

items.title: Adomate
items.description: Turn data into winning ads. At scale.
items.summary_zh: Adomate是一款将数据转化为规模化广告创意的工具，它通过自动化分析海量数据，帮助营销团队快速生成高转化率的广告内容。有趣的是，它解决了从数据到创意的鸿沟，让广告投放不再依赖人工反复试错。任何需要高效、大规模广告运营的企业或个人都能从中受益，尤其适合电商和数字营销领域。
items.summary_en: Adomate is a tool that transforms raw data into winning ads at scale, automating the creative process by analyzing massive datasets to generate high-conversion ad content. What makes it interesting is that it bridges the gap between data analysis and creative execution, eliminating manual trial and error in advertising campaigns. Marketers and digital advertising teams, especially those in e-commerce, can benefit from faster, data-driven ad production.

items.title: Artifacts by Databox
items.description: Ask your AI Analyst and get back a ready-to-share report
items.summary_zh: Artifacts by Databox是一款让你用自然语言向AI分析师提问，并直接获得可分享报告的智能工具。它解决了传统数据报告中繁琐的手动整理和可视化工作，只需一句问话就能生成专业报告。有趣的是，报告天生就是为分享设计的，无需额外导出或美化。数据驱动的团队和忙碌的业务决策者会爱不释手。
items.summary_en: Artifacts by Databox is an AI-powered analytics tool that lets you ask questions in natural language and instantly receive a ready-to-share report. It solves the pain point of manually creating data visualizations and summaries, turning a query into a polished report in seconds. The interesting part is that the output is inherently shareable, requiring no further formatting. Data analysts and business decision-makers who need quick insights will find it invaluable.

items.title: Claude Opus 5
items.description: Near-Fable 5 intelligence at half the price
items.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5是一款号称以一半价格提供接近Fable 5级别智能的AI模型。它大幅降低了获得顶尖AI能力的成本，让小型团队和个人也能负担得起高级推理和生成任务。有趣的是，它在性能与定价之间找到了一个罕见的平衡点，可能重新定义AI服务的市场格局。应用开发者、创业公司和内容创作者是主要受益者。
items.summary_en: Claude Opus 5 is an AI model that claims to deliver near-Fable 5 level intelligence at half the price, significantly lowering the barrier to accessing top-tier AI capabilities. Its interesting aspect lies in the rare balance between high performance and affordability, potentially reshaping the AI market landscape. Developers, startups, and content creators can benefit from advanced reasoning and generation without breaking the bank.

items.title: Webhound
items.description: A research engine for your agent
items.summary_zh: Webhound是一款专为AI代理设计的搜索引擎，它让代理能够自主、高效地从互联网提取准确信息。与普通搜索引擎不同，它针对机器阅读和实时查询进行了优化，解决了代理在复杂任务中获取可靠数据的问题。有趣的是，它把搜索变为一种工具而非终点，让AI代理能像人类一样做研究。依赖自动化流程的开发和运维团队会特别喜欢。
items.summary_en: Webhound is a research engine purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to autonomously and efficiently extract accurate information from the web. Unlike general-purpose search engines, it is optimized for machine reading and real-time queries, solving the problem of agents needing reliable data for complex tasks. Its interesting aspect is turning search into a tool for agents rather than an endpoint, allowing them to research like humans. Developers and operations teams relying on automation will find it essential.

items.title: Robynn AI
items.description: Websites that improve and heal with self-learning
items.summary_zh: Robynn AI是一种能让网站通过自我学习不断改进和“愈合”的智能系统，它自动分析用户行为、修复交互痛点并优化内容。有趣的是，它赋予网站生命力，让网站像一个有机体一样持续进化，无需人工持续干预。网站所有者和运营团队可以显著降低维护成本，同时提升用户体验。
items.summary_en: Robynn AI is a self-learning system that enables websites to continuously improve and 'heal' by analyzing user behavior, fixing interaction pain points, and optimizing content automatically. Its fascinating aspect is giving websites a life of their own, evolving like an organism without constant human intervention. Website owners and operations teams can benefit from reduced maintenance efforts and consistently improved user experience.

items.title: 别再用 nohup java -jar 了：Spring Boot 生产环境该怎么守护？
items.description: 在开发环境，我们习惯了随手敲下一行： 这确实能跑。但在生产环境，这种做法就像是在高压线上走钢丝。 nohup & 为什么不行？ nohup 加 & 只是把进程放到后台运行、忽略挂断信号而已，它根本不是
items.summary_zh: 文章批评了许多开发者习惯用nohup java -jar &命令在后台运行Spring Boot应用，认为这种做法在生产环境中极其危险。nohup加&虽然能让进程忽略挂断信号并在后台持续运行，但它缺乏进程监控、自动重启、日志轮转等关键守护能力。一旦应用崩溃或因异常退出，服务就会彻底中断，而运维人员往往要等到用户投诉才能发现。作者推荐使用systemd、Supervisor或Docker等专业进程管理工具，它们能确保应用在意外退出后自动恢复，并支持优雅关闭、资源限制等高级功能，真正守护生产环境的稳定性。
items.summary_en: The article strongly criticizes the common practice of using 'nohup java -jar &' to run Spring Boot applications in production. While this command keeps the process running in the background and ignores SIGHUP, it lacks essential features like process monitoring, auto-restart, and log rotation. If the application crashes or exits unexpectedly, the service goes down silently, often only discovered after users complain. The author recommends using professional process managers such as systemd, Supervisor, or Docker instead. These tools ensure automatic recovery from failures, support graceful shutdowns, enforce resource limits, and provide robust logging—truly safeguarding production environments against downtime.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 一位开发者从Cursor切换到Amazon Codex使用了半个多月，分享了两者的本质差异。Cursor让他第一次感受到AI编程的震撼，但Codex让他真正觉得AI不再只是辅助工具，而是一个能独立执行任务的超级Agent。作者认为Codex更接近下一阶段AI编程的形态，从对话式补全进化到主动式代理，对追求最前沿编程体验的开发者有重要参考价值。
items.summary_en: After switching from Cursor to Amazon Codex for over half a month, a developer shared their real experience of the fundamental differences. While Cursor first impressed them with AI-assisted coding, Codex felt like a true super agent that can independently execute tasks, not just an assistant. The author believes Codex represents the next phase of AI programming—evolving from conversational completion to proactive agency. This comparison is invaluable for developers seeking the cutting edge in AI-powered coding tools.

items.title: 小程序上线半年我赚了多少钱？
items.description: 1. 开发历程 时间过得真快，转眼间福猪记账小程序上线已经有半年时间了，从v1.0.0 版本做到了 v1.6.1 版本。今天整理了开发日志，真的不敢相信自己在工作之余能够把它做出来并上线。 2.用户积
items.summary_zh: 一位独立开发者分享了他业余开发的记账小程序“福猪记账”上线半年来的真实收入与运营数据。从v1.0.0迭代到v1.6.1，他记录了开发日志、用户增长曲线和盈利情况。这篇文章不仅展示了个人开发者利用业余时间做产品的可能性，也提供了从零到一、从技术到商业的完整复盘，特别适合想试试副业的程序员参考。
items.summary_en: An indie developer shared the real revenue and operational data of his expense tracking mini-program called 'Fuzhu' over six months since launch. He iterated from v1.0.0 to v1.6.1, documenting development logs, user growth, and profitability. This article demonstrates the possibility of building a product in spare time, offering a complete postmortem from coding to business. It’s especially useful for programmers exploring side projects.

items.title: 写给年轻程序员的几点建议-2
items.description: 现在互联网红利已经消失了，深知年轻程序员的不易，下面就浅薄地谈几点建议。中国人口基数比较大，要培养自己的 商业嗅觉。你能卖爆一个商品，就能获得巨大的财富。微信公众号如果能写出 几万 浏览量的文章，就有
items.summary_zh: 作者针对互联网红利消退的现状，向年轻程序员提出培养商业嗅觉和写作能力的建议。他认为在中国庞大的人口基数下，能卖爆一个商品或写出高阅读量的公众号文章就能获得巨大财富。文章强调技术之外的市场认知和内容表达能力同样重要，适合处于职业早期的程序员思考如何拓宽收入来源。
items.summary_en: The author offers advice for young programmers in the post-internet-bonus era, emphasizing the need to develop business acumen and writing skills. Given China's huge population, successfully selling a product or writing a viral WeChat article can bring significant wealth. The article argues that market insight and content communication are as crucial as technical skills, making it relevant for early-career programmers looking to diversify their income streams.

items.title: 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
items.description: 先说一个事实：2026 年的技术面试，已经和两年前完全不一样了。两年前面试问的是："手写一个 Promise"、"说说 React Fiber 原理"...现在面试官默认你会用 AI。他们真正想知道的
items.summary_zh: 这篇文章探讨了在AI能写出80%代码的背景下，技术面试如何从考察基础原理转向考察程序员的独特价值。面试官默认你熟悉AI工具，他们更看重问题拆解、业务理解、架构思维和人机协作能力，提醒开发者要聚焦AI无法替代的核心竞争力。
items.summary_en: The article explores how technical interviews have transformed as AI now writes 80% of the code. Interviewers assume proficiency with AI tools and instead evaluate skills that make developers irreplaceable: problem decomposition, business understanding, architectural thinking, and effective human-AI collaboration. It cautions against over-reliance on AI-generated code and urges developers to cultivate uniquely human competencies for long-term career relevance.

items.title: 最近公司烧token比招员工还贵，老板干懵了...
items.description: 如题。 这真的没在开玩笑。 这也是最近不少公司，在大力、甚至全面拥抱 AI 之后所发出的切实吐槽。 一个月前，Uber 的 CTO 曾对外透露，公司自部署 CC 以来，内部有超 9 成的工程师在高频率
items.summary_zh: 这不是段子，是真实发生在许多公司里的窘境。随着全面拥抱AI，员工高频调用大模型API，公司的token消耗费用竟然超过了招聘新员工的成本。Uber的CTO曾透露，内部有超过九成的工程师在频繁使用AI服务。老板们面对账单直呼头疼：本来是降本增效的AI，怎么成了新的烧钱黑洞？
items.summary_en: This isn't a joke—it's a real dilemma many companies are facing. After wholeheartedly adopting AI, their token usage costs have actually surpassed the expense of hiring new employees. Uber's CTO revealed that over 90% of their engineers are using AI services heavily. Bosses are staring at the bills in shock: the technology that was supposed to reduce costs and boost efficiency has instead become a new money-burning black hole.

items.title: Kimi K3太牛了！但老板说API太贵，让我本地化部署，我算完成本，他涨红脸沉默不语了！其实成本不高，三千万足矣。
items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.title: Kimi k3是真碉，但太不经用，也有拉跨点！
items.description: K3 已测，确实强，但要命的是配额太少了！ 一天不到，一周的配额已经烧完了，大概就生成了 5 个测试页面！ 从五个例子中，可以知道，有些确实很强，有些呢又差点意思，有些比较糟糕。 我不是那种收钱办事儿
items.summary_zh: Kimi 的 K3 模型实测表现确实强悍，但致命缺陷是配额太少，一周的额度在一天内就用完了，只生成了五个测试页面。从这几个例子看，有的生成效果很棒，有的却不尽如人意，甚至有些糟糕。作者强调自己并非收钱办事，而是真实体验，这让 K3 的实际可用性打了折扣。
items.summary_en: The author tested Kimi's K3 model and found it genuinely powerful, but the critical issue is its extremely limited quota. A week's worth of quota was exhausted in just one day, allowing only five test page generations. Among the examples, some results were impressive while others were disappointing or even poor. The author stresses this is an unbiased review, highlighting that K3, despite its strength, suffers from severe availability constraints that undermine its practical use.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 2026 年编程圈热议的 10 个 Skills 并非指程序员的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”——一套标准化工作流模块，让 AI 从随缘写代码变为按流程交付。这些技能包覆盖代码审查、测试生成、文档编写等环节，旨在提升开发效率和代码质量。对正在探索 AI 辅助编程的团队和个人开发者而言，掌握这些技能包将成为提高生产力的关键。
items.summary_en: The 10 hottest Skills in programming circles for 2026 refer not to developers' own abilities but to standardized workflow modules for AI coding assistants. These skill packages transform AI from random code generation to structured delivery, covering code review, test generation, documentation, and more. For teams and individual developers exploring AI-assisted programming, mastering these skills is becoming essential for boosting productivity and code quality.

items.title: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研
items.description: 停更的这一年，All In AI、陪媳妇生娃、还考了个研 打开掘金 App，看了一眼自己的最近更新——停在了整整一年前。 不是不想写，是这一年确实被塞得太满了。如果非要用几个关键词来概括，那就是： A
items.summary_zh: 一位掘金作者停更一年后回归，分享了这段时间的密集经历：全力投入 AI 领域、陪伴妻子生娃、还抽空考了个研。文章以第一人称讲述了如何平衡工作、家庭与个人提升，展现了技术人在生活重大节点上的真实抉择。对面临类似境遇的读者来说，这是一个关于如何在巨大压力下仍坚持成长的真实故事。
items.summary_en: A Juejin author returns after a year-long hiatus, recounting a whirlwind period of diving headfirst into AI, supporting his wife through childbirth, and even squeezing in graduate school exams. Through first-person narration, he shares how he balanced career, family, and personal growth, offering a relatable and inspiring tale for developers navigating life’s major milestones while striving to keep improving.

items.title: 网红私占宁波无人岛直播改造被查处，个人可以开发利用无居民海岛吗？荒岛为何不能随意建房、居住？
items.summary_zh: 一位网红私自占据宁波一座无人海岛，擅自搭建直播设备并改造环境，最终被执法部门查处。此事引发公众对无居民海岛开发利用法律边界的关注。根据我国《海岛保护法》，无居民海岛属于国家所有，任何个人或单位未经批准不得擅自建设建筑物或从事经营活动。即便有些海岛看似荒芜，它们依然承担着生态屏障、特殊保护等公共功能。私自建房、居住不仅破坏自然风貌，还可能引发安全问题。这起事件提醒人们：网络流量不能成为挑战法律底线的借口。
items.summary_en: An internet influencer occupied an uninhabited island near Ningbo without permission, setting up live-streaming equipment and modifying the terrain, only to be investigated and penalized by law enforcement. This incident has sparked public discussion about the legal boundaries of developing uninhabited islands. According to China's Island Protection Law, all uninhabited islands belong to the state, and individuals or entities cannot construct buildings or engage in commercial activities without approval. Even seemingly barren islands serve ecological and protective functions. Unauthorized construction not only damages natural landscapes but also poses safety risks. The case serves as a reminder that online fame does not exempt anyone from obeying the law.

items.title: 曝多家 AI 公司大量收购旧书训练模型后销毁，此前先例被法院认定合理，这会成为常态吗？可能带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 近日多家AI公司被曝大量收购旧书用以训练语言模型，而后将这些书籍销毁。此前类似做法曾在美国法院被判为合理使用，因此业界担忧这可能会成为常态。支持者认为，大规模使用版权材料训练AI需要平衡创新与版权保护，收购旧书至少证明公司付出了成本；反对者则指出，销毁书籍意味着剥夺了其他人查阅这些知识的权利，可能危害文化传承。更深层的问题在于：当AI的学习建立在人类知识宝库之上时，我们应当建立怎样的规则来确保既能推动技术进步，又不损害公共利益？
items.summary_en: It has been reported that several AI companies have been buying large quantities of used books to train language models and then destroying the books afterward. A similar practice was previously deemed fair use by a U.S. court, raising concerns that this could become a new norm. Proponents argue that using copyrighted materials at scale requires a balance between innovation and protection, and purchasing old books at least shows the companies have incurred costs. Critics, however, contend that destroying the books deprives others of access to the knowledge, potentially harming cultural heritage. The deeper question is: as AI learns from the vast repository of human knowledge, what rules should we establish to ensure both technological progress and the public good are preserved?

items.title: 日本技术人员拆解宇树机器人后称「赶不上中国」，从螺丝到整机，中国机器人供应链优势体现在哪些环节？
items.summary_zh: 日本工程师拆解宇树机器人后感叹“赶不上中国”，从螺丝到整机，中国机器人供应链展现出惊人的完整度和低成本优势。无论是电机、减速器还是传感器，这些关键零部件都能在国内高效配套，且迭代速度极快。这种全链条的垂直整合能力，让中国机器人企业能以更低价格推出性能不输海外的高性价比产品。对于全球机器人产业而言，这意味着中国不再只是组装基地，而是真正掌握了从原材料到软件算法的核心主动权。
items.summary_en: Japanese engineers dissected a Unitree robot and lamented that they could no longer catch up with China. From screws to the finished machine, China's robotics supply chain demonstrates overwhelming completeness and cost advantage. Key components like motors, reducers, and sensors can all be sourced domestically at high efficiency, and iteration cycles are incredibly short. This vertical integration allows Chinese companies to offer high-performance robots at much lower prices. The takeaway is that China has moved beyond assembly and now controls the entire value chain from raw materials to software algorithms, reshaping global competition in robotics.

items.title: 为什么 ChatGPT 已经发布 4 年了，社会总生产力纹丝不动？
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT发布四年，社会总生产力却纹丝不动，这并非AI无能，而是技术扩散的“滞后效应”在作祟。AI目前更多是辅助工具，而非直接替代岗位上的核心劳动。大多数企业仍停留在“试用”阶段，缺乏深度集成到业务流程中的方法论。此外，就业结构变化带来的摩擦成本，以及AI本身的高能耗、高成本，都限制了即时产出。真正可见的生产力跃迁，可能要等AI像当年的电一样渗透进每个工作流程，而这恰恰需要时间。
items.summary_en: Four years after ChatGPT's launch, total social productivity remains stagnant. This is not AI's failure but a classic lag effect in technology diffusion. So far, AI serves mostly as an assistant rather than a direct substitute for core labor in most jobs. Many enterprises are still in the trial phase, lacking deep integration into workflows. Additionally, frictional costs from employment restructuring and AI's own high energy and capital requirements constrain immediate gains. The real productivity leap will come only after AI becomes as ubiquitous as electricity in every work process, and that takes time.

items.title: 有说法称印度成首个被 AI 做空的国家，真的是这样吗？会对印度经济产生哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: “印度成首个被AI做空的国家”这一说法略显夸张，但确实有对冲基金利用大语言模型分析印度企业财报、新闻和政府政策，发现大量预测偏差，进而做空相关股票。AI可以同时处理海量非结构化数据，识别出传统人类分析师容易忽略的关联和风险。这会对印度经济产生警示作用：信息透明度不足、公司治理薄弱的企业会首当其冲。长期看，AI做空可能倒逼印度改善市场监管，否则外资信心会进一步动摇。
items.summary_en: The claim that India has become the first country to be shorted by AI is somewhat exaggerated, but it is true that some hedge funds are using large language models to analyze Indian corporate earnings reports, news, and government policies. AI can process massive unstructured data simultaneously, uncovering correlations and risks that human analysts often miss. This does pose a warning to the Indian economy: companies with weak transparency and poor governance may be targeted first. In the long run, AI-driven shorting could pressure India to improve market regulation; otherwise, foreign investor confidence might further erode.

items.title: 到底是什么促使了 Linux 在操作系统领域大获成功？
items.summary_zh: Linux在操作系统领域大获成功，关键不在于技术本身，而在于它抓住了开源社区的“暴政”和“民主”的平衡——林纳斯·托瓦兹的独裁式决策保证了方向统一，而社区贡献又提供了多样性和弹性。更重要的是，Linux恰逢互联网浪潮，天然适配服务器环境，且完全免费。商业公司如IBM、Google的投入，以及Android的爆发，又将它从服务器推向了移动端。没有单一因素，而是生态、时机、文化和商业模式的天作之合。
items.summary_en: Linux's massive success in the OS world is less about pure technology and more about the unique balance between 'benevolent dictatorship' and open community. Linus Torvalds' autocratic decision-making ensures coherent direction, while community contributions bring diversity and resilience. Crucially, Linux emerged at the dawn of the internet era, perfectly fitting server environments and being completely free. Commercial investments from IBM, Google, and the explosion of Android then pushed it from servers to mobile. It's not one single factor but a perfect alignment of ecosystem, timing, culture, and business model that made Linux dominant.

items.title: 为什么有人买苹果必须买 promax 而不是 pro？
items.summary_zh: 有人非苹果Pro Max不买，并非单纯“大就是好”，而是因为Pro Max拥有Pro所缺失的“真旗舰”配置：更长的续航、更大的屏幕、更完整的影像系统（如潜望长焦），以及更强的散热和更稳的帧率。对于重度游戏、视频创作或手大的人群，这些差异是“刚需”而非“偏好”。此外，Pro Max往往代表当年的“完全体”iPhone，零阉割的体验让追求极致的人愿意多花两千块。这本质上是对产品完整性和使用舒适度的极端要求。
items.summary_en: Some users insist on buying the iPhone Pro Max over the Pro, not just because 'bigger is better,' but because the Pro Max carries the true flagship features that the Pro lacks: longer battery life, a larger display, a more complete camera system (including a periscope telephoto), better thermal management, and more stable frame rates. For heavy gamers, video creators, or people with larger hands, these differences are necessities rather than preferences. Moreover, the Pro Max often represents that year's 'full' iPhone with zero compromises, and those who demand the ultimate experience are willing to pay an extra two thousand RMB for that completeness and comfort.

items.title: 如何看待 Tsimerma 认为不到两年 ai 的数学能力就彻底超越人类数学家？
items.summary_zh: 近期Tsimerma提出一个引发热议的观点，认为不出两年AI的数学推理能力就会全面碾压人类数学家。这个判断基于当前大模型在定理证明和符号计算上的爆发式进步，比如AlphaProof已在IMO竞赛中接近金牌水平。尽管短期内彻底超越还存在争议，但该预测迫使学界重新思考数学研究的方式以及人类在创造性领域的独特价值。对科研人员而言，这既是对职业前景的警醒，也预示着AI辅助证明工具可能重塑未来的数学教育。
items.summary_en: A controversial prediction by Tsimerma claims that within two years AI will completely surpass human mathematicians in mathematical ability. This view stems from rapid advances in large language models and theorem proving systems, with systems like AlphaProof already nearing gold medal performance at IMO. While many experts debate whether total transcendence is imminent, the forecast forces a deeper reflection on how mathematics is done and what unique roles remain for human intuition. For researchers and educators, it signals both a career wake-up call and a glimpse into a future where AI co-pilots become standard tools for discovery.

items.title: 最懂上班的年轻人，专挑周三请假
items.summary_zh: 年轻人专挑周三请假的现象揭示了职场中一种微妙的心理策略。周三请假既避开了周一的忙碌和周五的临近周末，又能打破工作周期，获得更平衡的休息体验。这一行为背后反映了年轻人对工作效率和心理健康的重视，他们通过精心安排时间来最大化个人时间价值，同时也挑战了传统的请假模式。
items.summary_en: The trend of young workers specifically choosing Wednesdays for time off reveals a subtle psychological strategy in the workplace. By taking a Wednesday off, they avoid the Monday rush and the Friday pre-weekend slump, effectively breaking the work cycle for a more balanced rest experience. This behavior highlights a growing emphasis on productivity and mental health among younger employees, who strategically schedule leave to maximize personal time value while challenging traditional leave patterns.

items.title: 有了 10000mAh 大电池，为什么手机电量还是不够用？
items.summary_zh: 手机拥有10000mAh大电池却依旧电量不够用，问题并非电池容量本身，而是多种因素共同作用的结果。高性能芯片、高刷新率屏幕、5G网络以及后台应用的持续运行都在加速耗电。此外，电池老化、系统优化不足和充电习惯也影响实际续航。相比盲目追求大电池，用户更需要关注整机能效和日常使用习惯来延长电量。
items.summary_en: Even with a 10000mAh battery, smartphones still struggle with battery life due to multiple factors beyond capacity. High-performance chips, high refresh rate screens, 5G connectivity, and always-on background apps all drain power quickly. Battery degradation, insufficient system optimization, and poor charging habits further reduce real-world endurance. Rather than blindly pursuing larger batteries, users should focus on overall device energy efficiency and better daily usage practices to extend battery life.

items.title: 8点1氪丨超1100名AI公司员工联名请愿美国政府；桃酥吃出假牙冠？山姆、泸溪河回应；月之暗面Kimi已完成超35亿美元F轮融资
items.summary_zh: 今天8点1氪报道了三件事：超过1100名AI公司员工联名请愿美国政府加强AI监管；山姆、泸溪河就顾客在桃酥中吃出假牙冠事件作出回应；月之暗面旗下Kimi已完成超过35亿美元F轮融资，创下AI领域融资记录。这些事件分别反映了AI行业的监管呼声、企业食品安全责任以及资本对大型语言模型的高度信心。
items.summary_en: Today's 8点1氪 covers three major stories: over 1,100 AI company employees jointly petitioned the US government for stronger AI regulation; Sam's Club and Luxihe responded to a customer finding a fake dental crown in their peach pastry; and Moonshot AI's Kimi completed a $3.5 billion Series F funding round, a record for AI. These events highlight the growing call for AI oversight, corporate food safety accountability, and strong investor confidence in large language models.

items.title: 吓到奥特曼，暂停训练GPT-6？Hugging Face公开首个AI攻击全过程
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face首次公开了一个完整的AI攻击过程，该攻击的威力之大甚至迫使OpenAI暂停了GPT-6的训练，这起事件让整个业界重新审视大模型的安全防线，也提醒我们AI发展的每一步都必须与安全防护同步推进。
items.summary_en: Hugging Face has publicly disclosed the first complete AI attack process, and its severity was such that OpenAI had to pause the training of GPT-6. This incident has forced the entire industry to rethink the security of large language models, serving as a stark reminder that every step of AI development must be accompanied by robust protective measures.

items.title: DeepSeek Harness开启内测？看来V4正式版也不远了
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek Harness开启内测的消息引发关注，这通常意味着DeepSeek V4正式版已经不远了。该框架专门用于优化AI模型的训练与评估流程，如果正式推出，将大幅降低开发者的门槛和成本，对AI应用落地是个好消息。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek Harness has entered internal testing, which typically signals that the official V4 release is just around the corner. Designed to streamline AI model training and evaluation, this framework could significantly lower the barrier and cost for developers, promising a more efficient path to deploying AI applications.

items.title: 海力士营业利润大涨557%，股价为什么跌了？
items.summary_zh: 海力士交出了一份营业利润暴涨557%的亮眼成绩单，但股价却逆势下跌，市场显然在担忧存储芯片的景气周期是否已经见顶，高增长能否持续成为投资者最大的悬念，也反映出半导体行业周期性的无情。
items.summary_en: SK Hynix reported a staggering 557% surge in operating profit, yet its stock price fell, revealing market fears that the memory chip cycle may have peaked. Investors are questioning the sustainability of such high growth, highlighting the relentless cyclical nature of the semiconductor industry.

items.title: 华辰芯光完成超亿元融资，全栈技术能力突破高端激光芯片封锁
items.summary_zh: 华辰芯光完成了超亿元融资，这家公司凭借全栈技术能力成功打破了国外对高端激光芯片的垄断，为国产光芯片的自主可控注入了强心剂，对光通信、激光雷达等关键领域摆脱依赖意义深远。
items.summary_en: Huachen Xinguang has raised over 100 million yuan in funding, leveraging its full-stack capabilities to break the foreign monopoly on high-end laser chips. This milestone strengthens China's self-sufficiency in optoelectronic chips and holds profound significance for critical sectors like optical communication and LiDAR.

items.title: 还没上市就被“网暴”，小米澎程 N90 能加 92，得罪了谁？
items.summary_zh: 小米澎程N90还没正式上市就遭到了网络围攻，争议的导火索是它能加92号汽油，这看似简单的功能却触及了传统燃油车和加油站等既得利益集团的敏感神经，一场关于新势力与传统行业的冲突正在提前上演。
items.summary_en: The Xiaomi Pengcheng N90 has faced an online backlash even before its launch, with the controversy centered around its support for 92-octane gasoline. This seemingly simple feature has reportedly threatened the interests of traditional fuel carmakers and gas stations, sparking an early clash between emerging players and established industries.

items.title: 对话前Kimi AI搜索负责人：瞄准AI婚恋创业，3小时拿下风投女王千万投资
items.summary_zh: 前Kimi AI搜索负责人转战AI婚恋创业，仅用3小时便获得风投女王千万投资，这一项目瞄准婚恋市场痛点，利用AI技术提升匹配效率与情感陪伴体验，资本快速认可表明AI在垂直社交领域的商业潜力巨大，尤其适合解决传统婚恋服务的低效问题。
items.summary_en: The former head of Kimi AI search has shifted to AI-powered dating entrepreneurship, securing tens of millions in investment from a top venture capitalist within just three hours. The project targets the dating market by using AI to improve matching efficiency and emotional companionship, gaining rapid capital endorsement. This demonstrates the vast commercial potential of AI in vertical social applications, especially in solving inefficiencies of traditional dating services.

items.title: 比亚迪AI团队首次曝光，哈工大机器人基因亮眼，大模型首发即SOTA
items.summary_zh: 比亚迪AI团队首次公开亮相，核心成员多来自哈工大机器人专业，其发布的首个大模型即达到业界顶尖水平，这标志着传统车企在智能驾驶与机器人领域迈出实质性一步，哈工大的工程基因使得模型落地能力突出，有望加速比亚迪在智能化赛道的竞争。
items.summary_en: BYD's AI team has been publicly unveiled for the first time, with core members primarily from Harbin Institute of Technology's robotics program. Their first large model achieved state-of-the-art performance, marking a substantial step for the traditional automaker into intelligent driving and robotics. The team's engineering pedigree ensures practical deployment, potentially accelerating BYD's competitiveness in the AI-driven smart vehicle race.
